WFRP4E_GRIMOIRE.Title: Tomes
WFRP4E_GRIMOIRE.EmptyEditable: These pages are blank. Drag spells here from a compendium, the Items directory or a character sheet.
WFRP4E_GRIMOIRE.Illegible: The writing means nothing to you.

Inventory.CopyTooltip: From a grimoire – disappears when the grimoire leaves the character. Memorise it to keep it.

Status.castable: Can be cast from the grimoire

Note.known: You already know this spell; you don't need the grimoire to cast it.
Note.castable: You can cast this spell while you carry the grimoire. It is on your sheet as a non-memorised spell with a book icon; its CN is doubled until you memorise it.
Note.readOnly: You don't know the Lore of {lore}, so you can only read this spell.
Note.none: Give the grimoire to a character to cast from it.
Note.notCarried: Mark the grimoire as carried to cast from it.
Note.unmemorized: This spell is on your sheet but not memorised: you cast it from the grimoire with doubled CN, and a miscast rolls on the Grimoire Miscast table. Memorise it to cast without the book.
Note.learnable: Petty spells are not cast from a grimoire. Memorise this one to add it to your Petty Magic.

Edit.DropHint: Drop entries on the pages to add them

Learn.Title: Memorise a spell
Learn.Confirm: {user} wants {actor} to memorise {spell} (has {current} XP). Allow? The system will then ask for the XP cost.
Learn.Denied: The GM did not allow memorising this spell.
Learn.NoGM: A GM must be online to approve memorising a spell.
Learn.Failed: Memorising the spell failed. See the console (F12) for details.

Settings.ConsumeOnFailureName: Failed scroll test uses up the scroll
Settings.ConsumeOnFailureHint: When off, a scroll is used up only after a successful casting test.
Settings.RenameScrollsHint: Inscribing an entry renames the scroll.

Scroll.Failed: Casting from the scroll failed. See the console (F12) for details.
Scroll.Consumed: {scroll} crumbles to dust – it was the last one.
Scroll.DropHint: Drop an entry on the scroll to inscribe it
Scroll.EmptyEditable: This scroll is blank. Drag a spell here from a compendium, the Items directory or a character sheet.
Scroll.NoteNoActor: Give the scroll to a character to cast from it.
Scroll.NoteConsume: Reading the scroll casts the spell with its normal CN; the scroll is used up whether the test succeeds or not.
Scroll.NoteConsumeOnSuccess: Reading the scroll casts the spell with its normal CN; the scroll is used up only if the test succeeds.

WFRP4E_GRIMOIRE.CreateHint: A book of spells and other writings. It is a Books and Documents trapping, so it works with the inventory and trading.
